acceptanceCriteria: A spec amendment defines an anchor key for request-less rejections, or records the limit as a documented abstention.
Tests cover a UI-state rejection with and without a positive sibling.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1737 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1101, head d102a537a, LPCV-V0-080..083). Expected: rejection witnesses asserted on UI state or an error code (no HTTP request) can be anchored against a positive sibling. Actual: the anchor key is (actor, method, route), so these always give UNKNOWN.
title: test-validity: UI-state and error-code rejections without a request stay UNKNOWN for rejection anchoring
